category_facts: Antiperspirants reduce sweat with aluminum compounds and are regulated as over-the-counter drugs; deodorants address odor and are cosmetics.
Real Skin Care's deodorant is aluminum-free and is a deodorant, never an antiperspirant.
When people switch from an antiperspirant to an aluminum-free deodorant, many notice an adjustment period of a few weeks while their underarms get used to the change.
Sodium lauryl sulfate (SLS) is the foaming agent in many toothpastes. Real Skin Care's toothpaste contains no SLS and no fluoride, so it foams less.
Real Skin Care's toothpaste is a gel made with organic virgin coconut oil and baking soda, flavored with mint, cinnamon or nothing at all.
Every Real Skin Care product is safe for kids.
